categories.main_business_segments: Qingdao Zhongzi Zhongcheng Group Co., Ltd. primarily operates in overseas integrated industrial park development and operation, EPC general contracting projects, mineral mining and sales, mechanical complete equipment manufacturing, construction services, property management, and domestic and international trade. The company focuses on the Indonesian integrated industrial park, including nickel and coal mining, power plant construction, and renewable energy projects such as wind and photovoltaic power. It also has domestic EPC business in new energy and construction sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes integrated industrial park development methods combining land acquisition, mining rights, infrastructure construction, and comprehensive services including logistics and waste residue processing. EPC projects involve engineering design, procurement, logistics, and construction management. The company emphasizes sustainable, ecological, and circular economy principles in park operations. It also employs advanced metallurgical equipment manufacturing and renewable energy EPC technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include industrial enterprises within the Indonesian integrated industrial park, mining companies, power plant operators, and renewable energy project owners. Major customers are PT. Metal Smeltindo Selaras and Energy Logic Philippines, Inc., among others. The company serves sectors such as mining, metallurgy, power generation, and industrial park tenants, focusing on Southeast Asia markets, especially Indonesia and the Philippines.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Indonesia, with significant assets and projects in Sulawesi and Kalimantan regions, and the Philippines. It also has subsidiaries and investments in Singapore, South Africa, and China. The domestic operations are based in Qingdao, China. The overseas business accounts for over 95% of revenue, highlighting a strong focus on Southeast Asian markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Qingdao Zhongzi Zhongcheng Group operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, including industrial park development and operation, EPC contracting, and mineral resource extraction and sales. It integrates upstream mining assets with downstream industrial park services and project construction, providing a full-chain service platform for tenants and partners.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on expanding and optimizing the Indonesian integrated industrial park, enhancing infrastructure and service capabilities, and increasing tenant attraction. It aims to deepen mineral resource exploration and development, extend into new energy sectors, and strengthen domestic and international EPC business. The company emphasizes risk management, cost reduction, and improving operational efficiency, with no significant R&D investment disclosed.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through industrial park land leasing, property management services, EPC project contracting fees, mineral sales, and equipment manufacturing and sales. The company also earns income from mining residue processing and other ancillary services. Revenue is largely project-based and contract-driven, with some recurring income from leasing and property services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company faces competition from other Chinese enterprises investing in Indonesian nickel industrial parks and mining sectors. However, due to the large scale and complexity of the park and mining operations, direct comparability is limited. Qingdao Zhongzi Zhongcheng leverages its government relations, overseas operational experience, and integrated service model to maintain a competitive position in the Southeast Asian industrial park and mining market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 136.7 million, a 70% decrease from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 310 million, showing improvement from prior losses but still negative. Total assets were about RMB 2.63 billion, with equity of RMB 172.6 million. The company has experienced continuous losses for six years, with high debt levels and cash flow challenges, but is implementing financing and operational measures to improve sustainability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers a comprehensive, one-stop integrated industrial park platform in Indonesia, combining resource acquisition, infrastructure, logistics, and full-chain services tailored to mining and metallurgical enterprises. Its strategic government relationships, local operational expertise, and mixed ownership structure provide stability and resource access. The EPC business complements park operations by delivering turnkey projects, while risk mitigation through contractual agreements and asset pledges differentiates its project execution and financial security.
